meta.homeDesc: MaurMaket is Haiti's marketplace app. Browse listings, chat with sellers, pay with MonCash or NatCash, and meet up safely to exchange.
meta.aboutDesc: Why we are building a trusted marketplace for Haiti.

hero.title: Buy and sell across Haiti
hero.lead: MaurMaket brings Haiti's marketplace online. Find what you need, talk directly with sellers, pay securely with MonCash or NatCash, and meet up to exchange — all in one app, in Kreyòl, French, or English.

discover.heading: Discover the marketplace
discover.sub: Fresh produce, handmade crafts, electronics, and fashion — browse what Haiti is selling right now.

features.heading: Why MaurMaket
features.sub: Everything the market already does — formalized, safe, and simple.
features.f1Body: Message sellers directly, share photos, and agree on a price — the way haggling already works, without leaving the app.
features.f2Body: Pay at checkout with MonCash, or pay the seller directly with NatCash when you meet. No cash hunts, no surprises.
features.f3Body: Arrange a meetup with an agreed place and time, check in when you arrive, and confirm the exchange with a code.

story.heading: Built for the way Haiti trades
story.sub: Chat, pay, and meet up — the whole deal stays in one place.
story.payBody: Check out securely with MonCash, or pay the seller directly with NatCash when you meet. Your money waits until the exchange is confirmed.
story.meetupBody: Agree on a place and time, check in when you arrive, and confirm the handoff with a code — no crossed wires, no surprises.

steps.heading: How it works
steps.sub: Three steps from browsing to handoff.
steps.s1Body: Search listings across Haiti, or open your own shop in minutes — free to start.
steps.s2Body: Talk directly with the other party, negotiate, and agree on the price and meetup details.
steps.s3Body: Pay with MonCash or NatCash, meet at the agreed spot, and confirm the handoff.

download.heading: Get the app
download.sub: MaurMaket is coming to Android first.
download.statusNote: The MaurMaket APK is not available yet. The download link will appear right here as soon as the first release ships.
download.paymentsNote: MonCash and NatCash supported at checkout and at meetup.
download.supportBody: Support will be handled right here on this site. The help center and case tracking open soon.

about.heading: About MaurMaket
about.lead: Haiti runs on informal commerce — in group chats, on street corners, and across market stalls. MaurMaket gives that energy a proper home: a marketplace built for how Haiti actually buys and sells.
about.s1Body: Kreyòl, French, and English from day one. Prices in gourdes. Meetups where you actually meet.
about.s2Body: Verified sellers, public reviews on completed purchases, and an order history that follows every account.
about.s3Body: Chat, offers, photos, payments, and meetups stay in one place — no more chasing a seller across five group chats.
about.v1Title: Your money waits for the item
about.v1Body: MonCash payments are held until the exchange is confirmed, so buyers and sellers meet as equals.
about.v2Body: Free to start, clear fees, and payouts straight to your MonCash.
about.v3Body: Meetup check-ins, report tools, and human review when something goes wrong.
about.ctaBody: The first release is almost here. The download link will appear on this page.

footer.contactNote: Support is coming to this site.

accountDeletion.title: Closing your account
accountDeletion.intro: Closing your account removes your personal data. The process runs in two stages: you request the closure, your account is held for seven days so you can change your mind, and after the hold the personal data is permanently removed.
accountDeletion.stageRequestBody: You start the closure from the app, under Data & privacy, then Close account. You confirm with your account password, or explicitly for accounts that sign in with Google only.
accountDeletion.stageFinalTitle: Stage 2 — The personal data is removed
accountDeletion.stageFinalBody: After the hold ends, we permanently remove the personal data described below. Records that must be kept for orders, payments, safety and legal reasons are retained, as explained in the Privacy Policy.
accountDeletion.exportBody: Before or during the hold, you can download a copy of the data we hold about you from the app.
accountDeletion.deletedBody: During the closure we remove the personal data tied to your account:
accountDeletion.deletedActivity: Saved items, follows and activity history
accountDeletion.keptBody: We keep only the records required by orders, payments and safety:
accountDeletion.blockersBody: Before the personal data is removed, open obligations must be resolved. You will see which ones apply before you confirm.
accountDeletion.closureBlocked: Some obligations are still open, so the closure cannot proceed yet.
accountDeletion.cancelBody: You can cancel a pending closure during the hold window. The account stays fully active.
accountDeletion.howToBody: Open the MaurMaket app, go to Data & privacy, then Close account, and follow the prompts.
accountDeletion.openAppNote: Opens the account-closing screen inside the app. If MaurMaket is not installed, or you are signed out, use the steps above instead — the same process runs in the app.
accountDeletion.supportBody: We will explain what happens to your data at each stage. You can also use the in-app Help & Support screen.
